explication: httptap is a Linux command-line tool that observes HTTP(S) traffic from a child program. The documented workflow is to run a command under httptap, intercept its network traffic, decode and summarize requests and responses, and optionally record HAR output. The graph separates process/network setup, protocol handling, and reporting support. Evidence is limited to the README and sampled excerpts; several runtime modules are present in the tree but were not inspected, so their detailed interactions are not asserted.
